properties.rationale: RULED 2026-09-15 (Anthony): STILL TRUE, RE-MEASURED TODAY. The exact query from the record — "record when a point in time actually happened so changes pinned to it can be ordered by date" — was run again against the 0.61.2 surface: add_epoch is still absent from the top five (invalidated_findings, set_evidence_scope, pin_at_epoch, invalidates, relation_candidates). plan_epoch no longer ranks, but nothing correct replaced it, so the catalogue still cannot route a user to the tool that records an arrival. The one listed repair, serving the wall check, is unrelated. A lexical catalogue that cannot tell a claim from its denial is a real ranking defect and a larger piece of work than a ruling; acknowledged for this repair so it stops reading as overtaken, and stays open on its own record.
